title: Server hooks in SvelteKit 3
notes: SvelteKit 3.0.0 (2026-10-01) moved the hook types (Handle, HandleServerError, sequence) from @sveltejs/kit to @sveltejs/kit/hooks and changed handleError: it now runs for every error and receives a `kind` discriminant ('app' | 'framework' | 'validation' | 'unknown') plus `error` and `event`, instead of v2's { error, event, status, message } for unexpected errors only. The v2 idiom from memory fails the type check (missing exports, no status/message on the input) and the behaviour check (404s and expected errors get their message replaced). Peers: svelte 5.57.x, vite 8, TypeScript 6.
